svg.title: Expanding center 7, the gap between indices 3 and 4
svg.desc: abacca. l is blue, r amber, the confirmed palindrome green. start l=3 r=4: c == c, widen. step 1 l=2 r=5: a == a, widen. step 2 l=1 r=6: r out of bounds, stop. Widest palindrome s[2..5] = acca.
svg.text: even case: center 7, the gap between s[3] and s[4]
